newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle showlists depleted - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle showlists depleted - feedlots.

text.p: Active cattle sales this week depleted showlists at most Plains feedlots, feedlot sources said.
Next week's showlists should be about the same size to somewhat smaller compared with this weeks', but may contain more short-fed cattle, sources said.

There were a few sales at $65.00 per cwt Wednesday, but cattle feeders said animals sold were lower-grading cattle. Better quality choice cattle would probably still bring $66.00, which was the bulk of the trading Tuesday, they said.
Beef prices remain weak, with USDA reporting beef cutout values up $0.01 to down $0.35 per cwt at midday on choice cuts and up $0.15 to down $0.10 on select cuts.
